MainComponents.name: Transmission Housing
MainComponents.description: Main casing that encloses and protects all transmission components.

MainComponents.name: Input Shaft
MainComponents.description: Transfers engine power into the transmission assembly.

MainComponents.name: Output Shaft
MainComponents.description: Delivers rotational power from transmission to the driveshaft.

MainComponents.name: Gear Set
MainComponents.description: Collection of gears used to change speed and torque ratios.

MainComponents.name: Synchronizer Assembly
MainComponents.description: Allows smooth gear shifting by matching gear speeds.

ClutchAndTorqueConverter.name: Clutch Disc
ClutchAndTorqueConverter.description: Engages and disengages engine power to the transmission input shaft.

ClutchAndTorqueConverter.name: Clutch Pressure Plate
ClutchAndTorqueConverter.description: Applies pressure to the clutch disc against the flywheel.

ClutchAndTorqueConverter.name: Release Bearing
ClutchAndTorqueConverter.description: Reduces friction and assists clutch pedal actuation.

ClutchAndTorqueConverter.name: Flywheel
ClutchAndTorqueConverter.description: Connects engine to clutch, storing rotational energy.

ClutchAndTorqueConverter.name: Torque Converter
ClutchAndTorqueConverter.description: Fluid coupling transmitting power in automatic transmissions.
ClutchAndTorqueConverter.material: Steel casing with turbine and stator blades

HydraulicAndLubricationSystem.name: Oil Pump
HydraulicAndLubricationSystem.description: Circulates transmission fluid through valves and clutch packs.

HydraulicAndLubricationSystem.name: Valve Body
HydraulicAndLubricationSystem.description: Controls fluid flow to different transmission components.

HydraulicAndLubricationSystem.name: Transmission Fluid Filter
HydraulicAndLubricationSystem.description: Removes debris and contaminants from transmission fluid.
HydraulicAndLubricationSystem.material: Steel casing with mesh filter element

HydraulicAndLubricationSystem.name: Transmission Pan
HydraulicAndLubricationSystem.description: Reservoir that holds and collects transmission fluid.

HydraulicAndLubricationSystem.name: Cooler Lines
HydraulicAndLubricationSystem.description: Carries transmission fluid to and from the cooler.

ControlAndShiftMechanisms.name: Gear Shift Lever
ControlAndShiftMechanisms.description: Manual or electronic lever used to select transmission gears.

ControlAndShiftMechanisms.name: Shift Cable
ControlAndShiftMechanisms.description: Transmits motion from the gear lever to the transmission.

ControlAndShiftMechanisms.name: Shift Fork
ControlAndShiftMechanisms.description: Engages and moves gears along the shaft during shifting.

ControlAndShiftMechanisms.name: Detent Mechanism
ControlAndShiftMechanisms.description: Holds the shift lever in selected gear positions.

ControlAndShiftMechanisms.name: Selector Shaft
ControlAndShiftMechanisms.description: Rotates to engage different gear selectors.

SensorsAndControlModules.name: Transmission Control Module (TCM)
SensorsAndControlModules.description: Electronic unit that manages gear shifts and pressure control.

SensorsAndControlModules.name: Speed Sensor
SensorsAndControlModules.description: Monitors input and output shaft speed for gear ratio control.

SensorsAndControlModules.name: Temperature Sensor
SensorsAndControlModules.description: Monitors transmission fluid temperature for protection and efficiency.

SensorsAndControlModules.name: Pressure Sensor
SensorsAndControlModules.description: Measures hydraulic pressure within transmission circuits.

SensorsAndControlModules.name: Range Sensor (PRNDL Sensor)
SensorsAndControlModules.description: Detects the selected gear position in automatic transmissions.

SupportingHardware.name: Mounting Brackets
SupportingHardware.description: Secures transmission assembly to the vehicle frame.

SupportingHardware.name: Seals and Gaskets
SupportingHardware.description: Prevents fluid leaks between transmission components.

SupportingHardware.name: Bearings
SupportingHardware.description: Supports rotating shafts and reduces friction.

SupportingHardware.name: Snap Rings and Retainers
SupportingHardware.description: Holds gears and bearings in place on shafts.

SupportingHardware.name: Transmission Mount
SupportingHardware.description: Absorbs vibration and stabilizes the transmission assembly.
